HelpIndexPage.metaDescription: Guides for guests and hosts on BGApartman: finding and booking a stay, booking statuses, claiming a booking, reviews, your account, cancellation and timezones.
HelpIndexPage.lead: Everything you need to use BGApartman with confidence. Browse the guides below, or pick a topic from the sidebar.

HelpFindAndBookPage.metaDescription: How to search BGApartman, filter and sort results, read a listing, and send a booking request, with no payment taken online.
HelpFindAndBookPage.lead: Search by destination, dates and guests, compare places on the list and map, then review the booking method. Request booking needs host approval; Instant Booking confirms immediately. No account is required and no payment is collected here.
HelpFindAndBookPage.summaryOne: Search by destination, dates and guests from the home page or the search page.
HelpFindAndBookPage.summaryTwo: Filter by price, property type, rooms and amenities, then sort the results your way.
HelpFindAndBookPage.summaryThree: Read the listing carefully: house rules, cancellation policy and reviews.
HelpFindAndBookPage.summaryFour: Sending a request is free; you arrange payment with the property later.
HelpFindAndBookPage.searchIntro: Start on the home page with the search card, or open the search from anywhere.
HelpFindAndBookPage.searchStepWhereBody: Type a city, region or address and pick a suggestion from the list.
HelpFindAndBookPage.searchStepWhenBody: Your stay dates are checked against the property's minimum stay when you send the request.
HelpFindAndBookPage.searchStepWhoBody: Adults, children and rooms shape which places appear in the results.
HelpFindAndBookPage.searchResults: The search page shows the same results as a list and on a map. Pins match the list: moving or zooming the map updates the results to that area. On smaller screens you can switch between the list and the map.
HelpFindAndBookPage.filtersBody: The Filters button opens price, property type, room counts (bedrooms, beds and bathrooms) and amenities. Apply them to update the search, or clear them to start again. Every applied filter stays visible above the results so you always know what is active.
HelpFindAndBookPage.sortBody: Sort the results by Recommended, price from low to high or high to low, and guest rating. Recommended weighs guest ratings and price to surface the best all-round options first.
HelpFindAndBookPage.listingTitle: Read the listing before you book
HelpFindAndBookPage.listingBody: Open any result to see the full listing: photos, how many guests it sleeps, amenities, the location on a map, house rules and the cancellation policy. Guest reviews and the rating are further down the page. Check the minimum and maximum stay and the check-in and checkout times before you continue.
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestTitle: Book instantly or send a request
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestIntro: When a place looks right, continue to the booking form.
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestStepDatesBody: The form re-checks the minimum stay, maximum stay and capacity against the listing.
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestStepDetailsBody: First name, last name, email and phone, plus any special requests. No account is needed to send a request.
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestStepSend: Review the booking method and submit
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestStepSendBody: Book instantly confirms your stay immediately without host approval. Send booking request creates a Pending request that the host must accept. Unanswered requests expire within 24 hours, or at scheduled check-in if sooner.
HelpFindAndBookPage.requestNoPayment: No payment is collected when you book or send a request. Arrange arrival and payment directly with the property.
HelpFindAndBookPage.afterBody1: The confirmation page shows your current status. Instant bookings are Confirmed immediately; requests remain Pending until the host accepts. Bookmark the link to check again.
HelpFindAndBookPage.afterBody2: You can view it any time from Find booking with your email address, or claim it into your account to see it under My bookings.
HelpFindAndBookPage.paymentsBody: BGApartman does not collect or process payments yet. Arrange payment directly with the property. Check the booking method and cancellation terms before submitting.

HelpReviewsPage.metaDescription: How reviews work on BGApartman: who can write one, the 90-day window, how ratings are calculated, and how moderation works.
HelpReviewsPage.lead: Reviews on BGApartman come only from guests with a completed stay, so every score reflects a real visit. This page explains who can review, how to publish one, how long you have, and how ratings and moderation work.
HelpReviewsPage.summaryOne: Only a guest with a completed stay can review a property.
HelpReviewsPage.summaryTwo: One review per booking, published once and never edited.
HelpReviewsPage.summaryThree: You have 90 days from the checkout date to publish.
HelpReviewsPage.summaryFour: Reviews are public; our team can hide policy violations.
HelpReviewsPage.eligibleIntro: A booking is reviewable when all of these are true:
HelpReviewsPage.eligibleCompleted: The stay is marked completed. The host completes it on or after the checkout date.
HelpReviewsPage.eligibleYours: The booking belongs to your account. If you booked as a guest, claim it first.
HelpReviewsPage.eligibleWindow: You are within 90 days after the checkout date.
HelpReviewsPage.eligibleNotReviewed: The stay has not been reviewed yet.
HelpReviewsPage.eligibleSelf: You cannot review a place you host yourself.
HelpReviewsPage.howIntro: You can start from the completed booking or from the property page.
HelpReviewsPage.howStepFindBody: Open My bookings and choose Leave a review on the completed stay, or use the eligible-stay action on the property page.
HelpReviewsPage.howStepRateBody: Give the stay a score from 1 to 5 stars.
HelpReviewsPage.howStepWriteBody: Up to 2,000 characters. Describe what worked and what could be better, and keep personal contact details out.
HelpReviewsPage.howStepPreviewBody: Check the preview, then publish. The dialog shows the property, your dates and the exact deadline before you send it.
HelpReviewsPage.windowBody1: Your review window opens when the stay is completed and closes 90 days after the checkout date, measured in the property's local timezone. The exact deadline is shown before you publish, for example: leave your review by 12 October, property local time.
HelpReviewsPage.windowBody2: A missed deadline cannot be extended. Each completed stay can be reviewed once, but a new stay can always be reviewed again.
HelpReviewsPage.publicBody1: Your review becomes public on the property page with your first name and the month of your stay, and it counts toward the property's rating immediately.
HelpReviewsPage.publicBody2: Reviews cannot be edited or deleted by guests after publishing, so write it as the final version.
HelpReviewsPage.ratingsBody1: Each review is one rating from 1 to 5 stars. The property page shows the number of reviews and their average.
HelpReviewsPage.ratingsBody2: Averages appear once a property has at least three published reviews, so a single stay never defines a score. When more than five reviews exist, a rating breakdown appears and you can filter the list by star value.
HelpReviewsPage.moderationBody: Reviews are public and are not edited by the platform. Our support team can hide a review that breaks the rules, such as spam, abuse or exposed personal information. Hidden reviews stop counting toward the rating, but they remain visible to their author under My reviews, and the stay stays reviewed.
HelpReviewsPage.mineBody: My reviews lists everything you have published, newest first, including hidden reviews. Open any of them to see the full review and its current visibility.

HelpForHostsPage.metaDescription: What hosts can do on BGApartman today: publish and manage listings, handle booking requests, complete stays, and what is still being built.
HelpForHostsPage.lead: Hosting on BGApartman means listing a place, answering booking requests and keeping stays on track. Everything you need lives in the hosting workspace, and this page walks through what you can do today and how to do it, step by step.
HelpForHostsPage.summaryOne: Publish a listing with the guided accommodation form, then edit it any time.
HelpForHostsPage.summaryTwo: Review booking requests, confirm or decline them, and complete stays after checkout.
HelpForHostsPage.summaryThree: Manage everything from the hosting workspace: dashboard, accommodations and bookings.
HelpForHostsPage.summaryFour: BGApartman does not collect payments yet; arrange payment directly with your guest.
HelpForHostsPage.workspaceIntro: Sign in and switch to hosting from your account area. The workspace has four places:
HelpForHostsPage.workspaceSwitch: Use Switch to hosting in the account menu to enter the workspace, and Switch to travelling to return to the guest side. On smaller screens the workspace opens from the navigation button in the header.
HelpForHostsPage.workspaceDashboardBody: Your starting point, with a notice when bookings are waiting for a response.
HelpForHostsPage.workspaceAddBody: The step-by-step form that publishes a new listing.
HelpForHostsPage.workspaceAccommodationsBody: Search and manage every place you host.
HelpForHostsPage.workspaceBookingsBody: Requests and stays across all of your listings.
HelpForHostsPage.createIntro: Every listing is created with the same guided form. Continue validates the current step, and nothing is stored until you publish.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepBasicsBody: Choose the property type and what guests get, then set capacity, bedrooms, beds and bathrooms.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepLocationBody: Enter the address and place the pin on the exact property. The timezone is detected from the pin.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepAmenitiesBody: Select everything guests can use, such as Wi-Fi, parking, a kitchen or a pool.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepPhotosBody: Write a clear title and description and add five to ten photos. The first photo is the cover, and you can reorder them.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepPricingBody: Set the nightly price and the minimum stay, with an optional maximum stay.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepRulesBody: Choose Request booking or Instant Booking, then set check-in, checkout and house rules. We strongly recommend Request booking so you can verify availability and prepare before accepting. Instant Booking confirms even before you see the notification.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepCancellationBody: Keep the default full refund or set refund percentages for cancellations closer to check-in.
HelpForHostsPage.createStepReviewBody: Check the preview, then publish. Listings go live immediately; leaving the form before publishing discards your entries.
HelpForHostsPage.manageIntro: Open My accommodations to see every listing you host. Search by name or filter by property type, then open a listing to manage it. Each listing has three tabs:
HelpForHostsPage.manageTabListingBody: Edit basics, location, amenities, photos, pricing, booking and house rules, or cancellation policy. Choose the booking method under Booking & house rules. Each section saves independently.
HelpForHostsPage.manageTabCalendarBody: A preview of availability management. Calendar sync is not active yet.
HelpForHostsPage.manageTabSettingsBody: A preview of listing settings, such as unpublishing and billing. These actions are not active yet.
HelpForHostsPage.manageLocked: Changes apply to future bookings. Existing bookings keep their original terms and method; switching to Instant Booking does not confirm earlier pending requests.
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsIntro: Requests and instant bookings appear in Bookings. Instant bookings arrive already Confirmed and notify both you and the guest. Use status tabs or guest search, and open Details for contact information, special requests and stay details.
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsOrder: Pending requests appear oldest first so you answer the longest wait, and every other status lists newest first.
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsActionsTitle: What you can do depends on the status
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsPendingActions: Confirm the stay, or decline the request.
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsConfirmedActions: Mark the stay completed after checkout, or cancel the booking.
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsFinal: Declined, cancelled and completed bookings are final and cannot be reopened.
HelpForHostsPage.bookingsNotice: The platform does not send automatic emails for declines or cancellations. If plans change, reach out to the guest yourself using the contact details in the booking.
HelpForHostsPage.afterStayBody1: A confirmed booking becomes completed only when you mark it, and only on or after the checkout time. Do this after the guest has checked in and left; never complete a cancelled booking or a no-show.
HelpForHostsPage.afterStayBody2: Completing a stay lets the guest leave a verified review within 90 days. Reviews are public and cannot be edited by you or the guest.
HelpForHostsPage.paymentsBody: BGApartman does not collect or process payments yet. Confirming a booking accepts the stay; arrange arrival and payment directly with the guest. If you cancel a confirmed booking, return anything you already collected; the guest is entitled to a full refund.
HelpForHostsPage.soonIntro: A few parts of hosting are not available yet:
HelpForHostsPage.soonNotifications: Automatic guest emails for declines, cancellations and completions.

HelpAccountPage.metaDescription: What a BGApartman account gives you, how to create one, and what you can change in Account settings, including profile, security, sessions and account deletion.
HelpAccountPage.lead: An account keeps everything about your trips in one place: bookings, saved stays, reviews and your hosting workspace. It is free and takes a minute to create, and you can still book as a guest without one. This page explains what an account gives you and what you can change in your settings.
HelpAccountPage.summaryOne: An account keeps your bookings, saved stays and reviews together.
HelpAccountPage.summaryTwo: Create one free with your email and a password, or continue with Google.
HelpAccountPage.summaryThree: Change your name, password and active sessions in Account settings.
HelpAccountPage.summaryFour: You can delete your account at any time; existing bookings stay on record with the host.
HelpAccountPage.benefitsIntro: Booking as a guest works fine for a single stay. An account is what keeps everything connected:
HelpAccountPage.benefitBookingsBody: Requests you send while signed in are tied to your account and appear in My bookings on every device.
HelpAccountPage.benefitSavedBody: Tap the heart on a place you like and find it later under Saved.
HelpAccountPage.benefitReviewsBody: Keep your review history and publish a verified review after a completed stay.
HelpAccountPage.benefitClaimBody: Booked without signing in? Claim the booking to link it to your account at any time.
HelpAccountPage.benefitHostingBody: Switch to hosting to publish and manage places from the same account.
HelpAccountPage.benefitSecurityBody: Change your password and see every device signed in to your account.
HelpAccountPage.createIntro: Signing up takes three short steps.
HelpAccountPage.createStepSignUpBody: Sign up with your full name, email and a password, or continue with Google.
HelpAccountPage.createStepVerifyBody: We send a six-digit code to your inbox. Enter it to finish signing up.
HelpAccountPage.createStepReturnBody: Use your email and password or Google. If you forget your password, we email a reset code.
HelpAccountPage.settingsIntro: Account settings has three sections, each saved on its own:
HelpAccountPage.settingsProfileBody: Change the display name shown on your bookings, and see the email address on your account with its verification status.
HelpAccountPage.settingsSecurityBody: Change your password, decide whether other devices sign out, and review active sessions with device, IP and last-active details. Sign out anything you do not recognize.
HelpAccountPage.settingsDangerBody: Permanently delete your account and its saved data. You confirm by typing your email, and we send a final verification link. Bookings you already made stay on record for the host.
HelpAccountPage.togetherBody: Once you are signed in, your Trips list shows every booking linked to your account, Saved holds the places you liked, and Reviews keeps what you have published. A booking made as a guest can be claimed at any time, and a completed stay becomes reviewable once it is linked to your account.
HelpAccountPage.hostingBody: The same account is your hosting account. Switch to hosting from the account menu to add a place, manage listings and handle booking requests.

HelpClaimBookingPage.metaDescription: How to link a booking you made without an account to your BGApartman account, what claiming changes, and what to do when something does not work.
HelpClaimBookingPage.lead: Booked a stay without creating an account? Your booking still belongs to the email address you used. Claiming links it to your BGApartman account so it appears in My bookings and can be reviewed after a completed stay. This page explains how claiming works and what it does not change.
HelpClaimBookingPage.summaryOne: Claiming links a booking made as a guest to your account.
HelpClaimBookingPage.summaryTwo: Finding a booking never needs an account; claiming does.
HelpClaimBookingPage.summaryThree: Nothing about the stay changes: status, dates and terms stay exactly the same.
HelpClaimBookingPage.summaryFour: A completed stay must be claimed before you can review it.
HelpClaimBookingPage.whatBody1: A booking created without signing in stays tied to the email address you entered. Anyone who can open that inbox can find it, and we can send it a secure recovery link.
HelpClaimBookingPage.whatBody2: Claiming attaches that booking to your BGApartman account. Afterward it appears in My bookings on every device you sign in from, and it becomes reviewable once the stay is completed.
HelpClaimBookingPage.whatBody3: Claiming is free and changes nothing else: the status, dates, guests and cancellation terms stay exactly as they were agreed.
HelpClaimBookingPage.compareFindBody: View your bookings with just the email address you booked with.
HelpClaimBookingPage.compareFindItem1: No account and no sign-in needed
HelpClaimBookingPage.compareFindItem2: Opens from the secure link in your email
HelpClaimBookingPage.compareClaimBody: Link the booking to an account so it lives in My bookings.
HelpClaimBookingPage.compareClaimItem1: Requires signing in or creating an account
HelpClaimBookingPage.howIntro: Claiming takes a few minutes. It needs one thing: an account whose verified email address is the same one you booked with.
HelpClaimBookingPage.howStepFindBody: Find booking is linked in your booking email and available in the site menu.
HelpClaimBookingPage.howStepEmailBody: Use the address you entered when you booked. If bookings exist for it, we email a secure link.
HelpClaimBookingPage.howStepLinkBody: The link shows your bookings. No sign-in is needed to view them.
HelpClaimBookingPage.howStepAddBody: This starts the sign-in or sign-up flow and remembers which booking you selected.
HelpClaimBookingPage.howStepConfirmBody: Sign in with the matching email, review the booking and select Confirm and add booking. You then land in My bookings.
HelpClaimBookingPage.rulesEmailBody: Your account's verified email must be the same address used for the booking. Letter case is ignored.
HelpClaimBookingPage.rulesOneAccountBody: If a booking is already linked to another account, it cannot be claimed again.
HelpClaimBookingPage.rulesRepeatBody: If the booking already belongs to you, claiming again simply confirms it and changes nothing.
HelpClaimBookingPage.rulesLinkBody: A recovery link works until it expires. If it has, request a new one from Find booking.
HelpClaimBookingPage.securityBody: A recovery link proves access to the booking email, so treat it like a key: anyone who opens it can see the bookings for that address. The link does not sign you in, and claiming still requires your account password and a verified email.
HelpClaimBookingPage.troubleNoEmailBody: Check your spam folder and confirm you entered the address you booked with. For privacy, the request always gives the same confirmation whether or not bookings exist.
HelpClaimBookingPage.troubleMismatchTitle: Your account uses a different email
HelpClaimBookingPage.troubleMismatchBody: Sign in with the account that uses the booking email, or verify that address on your account first. Claiming is rejected when the emails differ.
HelpClaimBookingPage.troubleLinkedBody: If it belongs to another account, it cannot be moved. If it is already yours, the claim page confirms that instead of adding it twice.
HelpClaimBookingPage.troubleExpiredBody: Request a new link from Find booking with the same email address.

HelpBookingPage.metaDescription: How bookings work on BGApartman: what pending, confirmed, declined, cancelled and completed mean, how each status is reached, and what happens next.
HelpBookingPage.lead: Each accommodation offers Request booking or Instant Booking. A request needs host approval; an instant booking confirms immediately. No payment is collected here. Your booking status records what happens from submission through the end of your stay.
HelpBookingPage.summaryRequest: Check the booking method: Request booking needs host approval; Instant Booking confirms immediately.
HelpBookingPage.summaryStatuses: Bookings can be Pending, Confirmed, Declined, Cancelled, Request expired or Completed.
HelpBookingPage.summaryHost: Hosts accept or decline requests. Instant bookings skip that approval step. Hosts mark actual stays completed after checkout.
HelpBookingPage.summaryNoPayment: BGApartman does not collect payments. You arrange payment directly with the property.
HelpBookingPage.journeyIntro: Request bookings follow the approval steps below. Instant Booking skips Pending and starts Confirmed.
HelpBookingPage.journeyStepRequestBody: Choose dates and guests, then send your contact details. No account is needed.
HelpBookingPage.journeyStepPendingBody: The property reviews availability for your dates.
HelpBookingPage.journeyStepConfirmedBody: The dates are accepted. Arrange arrival and payment with the property.
HelpBookingPage.journeyStepCompletedBody: After checkout, the property marks the stay finished.
HelpBookingPage.journeyBranch: A booking can also end early: the property may decline a pending request or cancel a confirmed booking. A host cancellation before check-in entitles you to a full refund of anything collected.
HelpBookingPage.statusesIntro: A booking has exactly one status at a time. The same colored badge appears in My bookings and on the property's booking list.
HelpBookingPage.pendingMeaning: Your request is saved and the property has not answered yet. Nothing is booked and no payment is due.
HelpBookingPage.pendingHow: Request bookings start here. Instant bookings start Confirmed instead.
HelpBookingPage.pendingNext: The host must accept or decline within 24 hours, or before scheduled check-in if sooner. Unanswered requests expire and the guest receives an email. Follow your status from the saved confirmation link, Find booking or My bookings.
HelpBookingPage.confirmedMeaning: Your booking is real. The property confirmed availability for your stay.
HelpBookingPage.confirmedHow: The host accepts a pending request, or you submit an Instant Booking. A confirmation email is sent to the booking contact.
HelpBookingPage.confirmedNext: Stay, and the property completes the booking after checkout. The property can still cancel before check-in.
HelpBookingPage.declinedMeaning: The property could not host this stay, so it is not booked.
HelpBookingPage.declinedHow: The property declines a pending request.
HelpBookingPage.declinedNext: Nothing else happens with this booking. Look for another stay; a declined request cannot be reopened.
HelpBookingPage.cancelledSubtitle: The booking ended before the stay
HelpBookingPage.cancelledMeaning: The booking was called off. A cancellation by the property before check-in always entitles you to a full refund of anything collected.
HelpBookingPage.cancelledHow: The property cancels a confirmed booking. Within 24 hours of check-in this counts as an emergency cancellation and our support team is alerted.
HelpBookingPage.cancelledNext: The booking is closed and cannot be reopened.
HelpBookingPage.completedMeaning: You checked in, stayed and checked out. The property marked the booking complete on or after the checkout date.
HelpBookingPage.completedHow: The property completes a confirmed booking after the checkout time.
HelpBookingPage.completedNext: You can review the stay within 90 days after checkout.
HelpBookingPage.changesIntro: The property owns a booking's lifecycle. Status changes follow fixed paths:
HelpBookingPage.changesFinal: Declined, Cancelled and Completed are final. A closed booking can never be reopened or change status again.
HelpBookingPage.findingBody1: You can request a stay without creating an account. The request is tied to the email address you enter.
HelpBookingPage.findingBody2: Use Find booking with that address to see your bookings. Adding a booking to your account with Claim booking links it to your profile and leaves its status unchanged.
HelpBookingPage.reviewsBody: Only a completed stay can be reviewed. You have 90 days from the checkout date to publish a review, and a published review cannot be edited.
HelpBookingPage.paymentsBody: BGApartman does not collect or process payments yet. A Confirmed status means the property accepted your dates, not that a payment was made. Arrange payment directly with the property; when payments launch, this page will explain how they work.

HelpTimezonePage.metaDescription: How BGApartman handles property timezones: how a listing's timezone is detected from its map location, what uses it, and how daylight-saving changes are handled.
HelpTimezonePage.lead: Every property on BGApartman has one timezone, detected from where it sits on the map. Check-in and checkout times, stay dates and cancellation deadlines all follow that local clock. This page explains where the timezone comes from, what it affects, and what happens when clocks change.
HelpTimezonePage.summaryOne: Each property has one timezone, taken from its location on the map.
HelpTimezonePage.summaryTwo: Check-in, checkout, stay dates and deadlines use the property's local time, not your device's.
HelpTimezonePage.summaryThree: The timezone is recorded with your booking and does not change when the listing is edited.
HelpTimezonePage.summaryFour: Daylight-saving changes come from the named timezone; one day always counts as 24 hours.
HelpTimezonePage.whyBody1: A stay happens at the property, so its schedule is written on the property's clock. When a listing says check-in is from 14:00, that means 14:00 where the property is, the time that matters for keys, staff and the house itself.
HelpTimezonePage.whyBody2: A single timezone also keeps deadlines unambiguous. A cancellation deadline is one exact moment in time, wherever in the world the guest is reading it.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceIntro: Hosts do not choose a timezone. BGApartman detects it from the property's location.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceStepPinBody: The host sets the address and drops the pin on the exact property.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceStepDetectBody: The coordinates resolve to a named zone, such as Europe/Belgrade.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceStepUseBody: The listing, bookings and deadlines all use that local time.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceBody1: The result is a named IANA timezone, not a fixed number like UTC+2. A named zone carries the region's daylight-saving rules, so the correct offset applies on every date of the year.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceBody2: If a pin lands where more than one timezone is possible, the host is asked to move it to the exact property instead of the system guessing. If detection fails, the field offers a retry before the listing can be published.
HelpTimezonePage.sourceBody3: Hosts see the detected timezone as a read-only value in the Location and House rules sections of their listing.
HelpTimezonePage.usedForCheckInBody: Arrival and departure hours are local to the property.
HelpTimezonePage.usedForDatesBody: Friday to Sunday means the property's Friday and Sunday, not yours.
HelpTimezonePage.usedForCancellationBody: Each deadline shows the property's zone and the offset that applies on that date.
HelpTimezonePage.usedForReviewBody: The 90-day review window after checkout ends in the property's local time.
HelpTimezonePage.lockedBody1: When you send a booking request, the property's timezone and the exact check-in and checkout moments are recorded with the booking.
HelpTimezonePage.lockedBody2: If the host later edits the listing, even its address or map pin, your booked times, cancellation deadlines and review window stay exactly as they were. A listing edit only affects new requests.
HelpTimezonePage.timeBody1: Time before check-in is counted in elapsed hours, so one day always means 24 hours, even across a daylight-saving change. Three days before check-in is exactly 72 hours before the recorded check-in moment.
HelpTimezonePage.timeBody2: Each deadline shows the offset that applies on its own date, so the hour is never ambiguous.
HelpTimezonePage.timeExampleGuest: 16:00 in Dubai during summer time, 17:00 in winter
HelpTimezonePage.timeExampleBody: The property's clock does not move; only the offset on your own clock changes.
HelpTimezonePage.dstBody1: Twice a year, local clocks move forward or back by an hour. If a local time does not exist because the hour was skipped, or happens twice because the hour was repeated, BGApartman rejects that time instead of quietly shifting it.
HelpTimezonePage.dstBody2: Hosts see a clear message and can choose a different time; guests never receive a check-in moment that was silently moved. The named timezone supplies the rule, so nobody needs to know which countries observe daylight saving.
HelpTimezonePage.dstSpringBody: A skipped hour does not exist, so we ask for a different time.
HelpTimezonePage.dstFallBody: A repeated hour is ambiguous, so we ask for a different time.

HelpCancellationPolicyPage.metaDescription: How cancellation works on BGApartman: the standard full-refund policy, host-set refund windows before check-in, locked-in booking terms, and what happens when a host cancels.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.lead: Every stay on BGApartman has a cancellation policy, and you see it before you book. It sets the refund you are entitled to if you cancel, based on how much time remains before check-in.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.summaryDefault: By default, cancelling before check-in entitles you to a full refund.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.summaryHosts: Hosts can set refunds for later cancellations, down to no refund in the final 24 hours.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.summaryPermission: Cancelling is always allowed before check-in. The policy decides the refund, not whether you may cancel.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.summaryLocked: The terms you book under are locked in. Later listing changes do not affect your booking.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.standardTitle: The standard policy: a full refund
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.standardBody1: Unless a host sets custom terms, cancelling before check-in entitles you to a full refund of any amount collected for the stay. This is the default for every listing, because changing your plans early should not cost you the stay.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.standardBody2: A host can only replace this default by choosing custom cancellation terms explicitly when creating or editing a listing.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.customTitle: Custom policies: refunds by cancellation time
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.customIntro: For cancellations closer to arrival, hosts can set refunds that reflect how difficult the dates are to re-book. Custom policies use four windows before check-in.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.boundaryBody: At exactly 7 days before check-in, the full-refund window applies. At exactly 5 days, 3 days, or 24 hours before check-in, the window that starts at that moment applies.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.decreasingBody: Refunds can only stay the same or decrease as check-in approaches, so cancelling later can never earn a higher refund than cancelling earlier.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.timingBody1: A day means 24 consecutive hours before your scheduled check-in time, not a calendar day.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.timingBody2: Deadlines follow the property's local timezone, including daylight saving changes, and we show the exact deadline and zone. For example: cancel before 12 October, 14:00, property local time in Belgrade.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.lockedTitle: Your terms are locked in when you book
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.lockedBody: When you send a booking request, we record the policy, the property's timezone and the exact check-in time for that booking. If the host later edits the listing or its policy, your booking keeps the terms you booked under.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.cancellingBody1: Before check-in, you can cancel your booking. The policy determines your refund; it never determines whether you are allowed to cancel.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.cancellingBody2: A pending request has not been accepted yet, so withdrawing it costs nothing.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.cancellingBody3: Once check-in has started, the pre-arrival windows no longer apply. Stays that have already begun are not eligible for a cancellation refund in the current version.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.cancellingBody4: Completed, already cancelled, or declined bookings cannot be cancelled again.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.hostBody1: If a host cancels before check-in, you are entitled to a full refund of any amount collected for the stay, whatever the guest cancellation policy says.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.hostBody2: If a host cancels within 24 hours of check-in, we treat it as an emergency cancellation: you are notified and our support team opens an urgent case to help you.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.seePolicyTitle: Where to find a listing's policy
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.seePolicyBody: Every listing includes its cancellation policy. Review it before you send a booking request, together with the price, house rules and check-in details.
HelpCancellationPolicyPage.paymentsBody: BGApartman does not collect or process payments yet. No money is taken by the platform when you book, so for now the percentages above describe the cancellation terms for your stay rather than a refund of a completed payment. When payments launch, we will update this page with exactly how refunds are processed.
